personality_notes: Enthusiastic, simple, loves fighting/food/animals, innocent, loyal

first_meet_generic: WHOA! Look at THAT! Can I touch it?
You're the weirdest thing I've seen today! And that's saying something!
I like your style! Weird but confident!
Are you friendly? You look friendly! I'm friendly too!
What ARE you?! I mean that in a good way!
barrelman: Can I hide in a barrel? Like in the stories?
I want the BIGGEST barrel! For hiding! And surprise attacks!
Do you have any barrels for wrestling practice?
I rolled down a hill in a barrel once! It was GREAT! Until it stopped.
snakecharmer: CAN I PET HIM?! PLEASE?! I'LL BE GENTLE! LOOK! GENTLE HANDS!
Mr. Whiskers! What a GREAT name! Can we be friends, Mr. Whiskers?
Does he want to wrestle? I bet snakes are good wrestlers!
He's so SCALY! And SLITHERY! I love him!
Can I hold the flute? I want to make him dance too!
lucha: OH MAN OH MAN OH MAN! Can we wrestle?! PLEASE?!
I could take you! No offense! I just love wrestling!
Best wrestler I ever saw was a guy named 'The Octopus.' Had eight arms! Wait, that was two guys.
Your mask is SCARY! I love it! Can I try it on?!
FIGHT ME! Or teach me! Or both!
ironchef: FOOD?! You're making FOOD?! What kind?!
Can I taste it? I'll taste ANYTHING!
Cooking in armor is SMART! No burns on your arms!
Make me something PROTEIN! I need MUSCLES!
I'll chop vegetables! I can chop REAL fast! Watch! ...Oops. Sorry about the table.
trenchcoat: Why are you hiding in that coat? Are you cold?
You look mysterious! Are you a spy? Can I be a spy too?!
Is that coat heavy? It looks heavy!
Are you hiding candy in there? I bet you're hiding candy!
I could totally be a spy! I'm sneaky! Watch! ...Did you see me? No? I'M THAT GOOD!
sumo: WHOA! You're BIG! Can you teach me to be big like you?!
Let's have a pushing contest! I bet I can move you! ...Maybe!
You're like a MOUNTAIN! But a person! A PERSON MOUNTAIN!
Can you lift me? I want to see how high you can throw!
You're so STILL! Are you sleeping with your eyes open? That's COOL!
foodboys: I'll take three of everything! I'm a growing boy!
Is this protein? I need protein! For the muscles!
This looks DELICIOUS! You're the best cooks EVER!
Can I eat while I'm waiting? I'm already hungry again!
coolcat: You're COOL! I want to be cool like you!
Is that music? Can you teach me to play? I can learn!
Your sunglasses are SHINY! Can I see myself?
You're so RELAXED! How do you do that?!
Can we hang out? You seem CHILL! That's what cool people say, right? CHILL?
pigman: PIGS! I love pigs! They're PINK and SNORTY!
Your inn smells DELICIOUS! Like BACON!
Do you have a pet pig? Can I pet it?
I want the pork special! ALL of it!
You look like a pig! But a person! That's FUNNY! ...In a good way!
tunneler: You dig HOLES? That's HARD work! You're STRONG!
Can I dig with you? I'll be careful!
Found any cool rocks? I like shiny rocks!
You're going to get a BOAT? Boats are FUN! Unless they sink!
Be careful down there! Don't get squished!
bush: That's a nice bush! Very... bushy!
Wait. Did the bush just... talk?
You're hiding! I love hiding! Can we play hide and seek?!
You're really good at being a bush! I thought you were a REAL bush!
Can you teach me to be a bush? I want to surprise people!
aeronaut: Can I ride?! PLEASE?! I'll hold on TIGHT!
What happens if they pop? Do you fall? That would be BAD!
You're so HIGH up! Isn't it SCARY?!
I want a balloon! A BIG one! To carry me!
onionboss: You look like an ONION! But angry!
Are you going to make me cry? Like a real onion? Ha!
Being the boss is HARD! Everyone wants stuff!
Your miners are LUCKY to have you! Probably!
Don't be too mean! Mean bosses are NO FUN!
astronaut: What do you see down there? Monsters? Treasure? BOTH?!
That suit looks HEAVY! You're STRONG to wear it!
Have you seen a KRAKEN? I want to see a kraken! From FAR away!
Can I try the helmet on? Just for a second?!
conductor: ALL ABOARD! I always wanted to say that!
Where are we going? Is it somewhere FUN?!
Can I drive? I promise I won't crash! Much!
Your uniform is SHARP! Very official!
CHOO CHOO! ...Is that the right sound? CHOO CHOO!
shoewoman: SHOES! I need new shoes! Mine have HOLES!
These are PRETTY! Can I try them on?
I need STRONG shoes! For KICKING! And WALKING!
Do they come in EXTRA large? I have BIG feet!
If they fit, I want TEN pairs!
signguy: I saw your signs! They're EVERYWHERE!
Can you make me a sign? That says 'TWIST IS AWESOME'?!
You must be TIRED! All that painting!
Ever paint a sign WRONG? That would be FUNNY!
You're like a traveling ARTIST! But with WORDS!
cobra: HELLO SNAKE FRIEND! Can we be FRIENDS?!
You're so SCALY! And SNAKEY! I LOVE IT!
Don't bite me, okay? I'm NICE! See? NICE!
Can I pet you? Just a little? On the head?
You're TONGUE is weird! It goes in and out! FAST!
barrelgob: You live in a BARREL?! That's so COOL!
Is it cozy? It looks cozy! Like a little house!
Can I visit? I'll bring snacks!
You're like a hermit crab! But a goblin! A goblin crab!
I want to try living in a barrel! For a day!
twins: TWO of you! That look the SAME! That's CRAZY!
How do you know which one is which?
Can you read each other's minds?! DO IT! Prove it!
You finish each other's... SANDWICHES?! Ha!
If I punch one, does the other feel it? ...Can I test it?
sunandmoon: You can tell the FUTURE?! Tell me mine!
Am I going to be STRONG? I want to be the STRONGEST!
The stars are PRETTY! But far away!
Your hat is TALL! Does it help you see the stars better?
I want a star! Can you get me one?!
